scope: Explicit temporary-room guest preview, local device checks and guarded entry
checks: Opening a new temporary invitation does not contact its relay or publish admission
Repeated request taps produce one immutable signed request
Waiting follows a real relay acknowledgement
Cancellation closes the request collector and ignores a late grant
Only authenticated matching refusal ends the current request
Retry retains the name and requires another deliberate request
Signed admission opens one saved room and leaving returns home
Local device checks stop before request, late permissions cannot restart inputs
An existing call keeps its inputs out of the preview
remainingAcceptance: Physical camera and microphone capture and permission refusal
Physical keyboard, background and lifecycle checks
Cross-client host and guest acceptance with unfamiliar users
Offline and background hosts, expired links and anonymous creation
Full G17 acceptance and native call recording remain open
